text_simplified: Islamic law mandates justice among children and prohibits oppression and favoring some over others in giving. Al-Nu'man ibn Bashir (may Allah be pleased with them both) reported that his father gave him a gift and wanted the Prophet ﷺ to witness it. The Prophet ﷺ asked: "Have you given all of your children the like of this?" He said, "No." The Prophet ﷺ said: "Fear Allah and be just between your children," so he returned and took back his gift (Sahih al-Bukhari — 2587). In another narration in Sahih Muslim, the Prophet ﷺ said: "I do not bear witness to injustice" (Sahih Muslim — 1623).
